Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class SessionDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.SessionDTO
public class SessionDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for Session entity.

Represents session metadata for a user's active or expired login token, including lifecycle timestamps, status, and client-specific identifiers. Primarily used in authentication systems, session tracking dashboards, or security auditing workflows. JAXB annotations support XML serialization for REST endpoints and interoperability with external systems.

Attributes: - id: Unique identifier for the session record - createdAt: Timestamp when the session was created - expirationDate: When the session token is set to expire - sessionToken: Token string used to maintain session authentication - isActive: Flag indicating if the session is still valid - ipAddress: IP address from which the session originated - userAgent: Client-specific identifier (e.g., browser info, device) - userId: ID of the user associated with this session
